The new type quantifies N, p in [0,1], and a full Record N, and interprets VariableRegisteredSamples.productRowLaw.toPMF. The new theorem fixes the observed full record to all false, retains arbitrary N and p, and calculates a real atom probability of a product experiment. A time-zero initialization does not establish this likelihood. The new proof correctly uses trainingLaw_apply and AbsorbingLeakage.kernel_mass.

The fixed p=3/4 two-action factorization has neither a variable source parameter nor the arbitrary-N record carrier needed here. The new theorem derives degeneracy at p=0 from trainingLaw_zeroRecord and standard PMF support/extensionality facts.

The new Unit-action source has both stay and goal edges at start with positive p in {1/4,1/8}. Different rows and action carriers require the new positivity/map-support proof; the old literal source theorem is not substitutable.

The old finite-memory-check witness is a deterministic Bool flip source, no cemetery and no numerical uncertainty. Its flipRelation proof by pure support cannot establish the two-positive-edge support of the new source.

The old model_support_exact reconstructs the old deterministic Bool-action PMF from its numerical Model and proves agreement with its old relation. The new theorem concerns its own parameterized PMF directly; no equality with that Model is established or needed.

The old initial_support_exact is a unary membership equivalence for the initial Finset and PMF.pure start. The new statement is a time/state/action/successor transition support equivalence. The new witness separately proves its own initial support premise; that shared starting state does not establish its transitions.

The old SafePrefixDeadend source deterministically chooses the action at n=0 then holds the state thereafter, with Bool states/actions and a time-indexed supportTable. The new support is stationary, stochastic, and on Option Bool with Unit actions. The reversed iff orientation is incidental; the source contracts differ materially.
